decided.singular: These are the bumps that clearly rise above the 5-25 baseline of the smoothed curve: about 51 at 150-153, about 41 at 315, about 35 at 273-275 and about 36 at day 1, plus a plateau of about 25 at 162-166.
decided.recurrence: The curve does show regular undulations, but they are spaced about 13-14 days apart (for example 44, 58, 71, 84, 97), not 20-35 days, and the larger peaks are not evenly spaced, so I can't confirm a period in that range.
decided.quarter: Q2 has a curve that stays high (peaks in the 20s around 97-140) plus the year's largest event (about 51 at day 152), so it has more area under the curve than Q4, which has two sharp peaks but lower stretches between them.

answer.guess: A smoothed daily geomagnetic activity index, possibly a running mean of ap or of 3-hourly Kp converted to ap units.
